integrity: A self-contained proof and exact symbolic/finite-field verifier accompany the claim; the all-extension point formula is a cohomological deduction rather than finite enumeration. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the e3 elementary-symmetric characteristic-three model, not the degenerate naive power-sum reduction. It does not compute the Artin invariant, an integral Picard basis, or all characteristic-prime specializations. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Fifteen rational nodes and a supersingular zeta function for the characteristic-three Clebsch Hessian
